versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the figma-design-qa skill.
- Provides a structured, pre-handoff QA checklist for Figma designs, covering file hygiene, component usage, content, states, accessibility, and handoff readiness.
- Produces a clear QA report with explicit pass/fail status and actionable feedback for each item.
- Optimized for use with Opus 4.7 and newer models.
- Ensures full coverage of design quality standards and handoff requirements before engineering.
